title: rosa humilis
intro: Rosa humilis, commonly known as the climbing rose or wild prairie rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa humilis are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Rosa humilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
